Review Text:
Talkeetna Alaska, K2 Aviation Grand tour of Denali - landing on the Ruth Glacier for a beautiful view of the summit. I was born and raised here and had been in the park a million times BUT flying near around and landing on - I want to do it again and MORE.

Bring your camera, sunglasses and comfortable clothing. We had great weather but be prepared.

Loved K2 staff - professional and very helpful -

It's an all day event. Drive time from Anchorage to Talkeetna - 2 - 3 hours, flight 2 hours and you want time in Talkeetna.

Review Text: From start to finish, our flightseeing tour from Talkeetna to Mt. McKinley, landing on Ruth Glacier was jaw-droppingly wonderful. I've lived in Alaska for almost 40 years and thought I'd seen its beauty, but this trip showed me sights I hadn't even imagined. It was well worth every penny, and I'll remember it as long as I live. The best compliment I can give is to say that the minute we landed, I wanted to go right back and do it again. The staff at K2 was very helpful, and Al the pilot was very safety minded and also extremely knowledgeable about the terrain over which we were flying. And landing on the glacier. By all means, be sure and do this. Standing so near the peak of the highest mountain in North America was awe inspiring. Yes, I'm gushing, but you would be too if you'd taken this trip. I highly highly highly recomend it.

Review Title: 1 of the top 10 best things I've done in my life"
Review Text: After so many days of dreary weather, Friday greeted me with a spectacular sunny day. On a spur of the moment I decided to make a run up to Talkeetna to take advantage of K2's AK resident birthday discount. It was the best idea I ever had. It was awesome! The discount allowed me to experience breathtaking views of McKinely as pilot Mike took us around the mountain. Mike made sure that both sides of the plane got to see all the views. He pointed out all the different peaks and we even saw the climbers base camp. Then we landed on Ruth Glacier..so peaceful, serene, and just flat out awesome. We got to walk around the landing sight and just take in all of natures beauty. On the way back we were able to see some bull moose by the river. I would definitly recomment this to anyone, especially AK residents. I can't believe I never did this before in the last 24 yrs I've been in AK. AWESOME!!!!!!!!!!!!

Review Text: We arrived for our scheduled K-2 flight around Denali (green route) and were told that the full trip was not possible due to weather conditions.   We opted for the offered "orange" route instead.  Once above the cloud cover we got some great views of the mountain and were able to land on the glacier, which was awesome.  We enjoyed every minute of it.  My only disappointment was that they charged us for the "orange" route, but the flight did not take us on the path of that route due to cloud cover.  Instead, the pilot made a few extra zig-zags along the "blue" route flight path to add some extra time to the trip.  Unfortunately, neither the pilot or anyone else asked us if this substitution was o.k. with us.  They assumed that adding a few extra minutes flight time was a fair substitute for seeing more of the mountain....in my opinion it wasn't.

Review Text: We were originally scheduled to take an evening flightsee at 7pm including a glacier landing. Because of the weather, it was postponed until the next morning at 11am. At that time, the weather still weren't allowing them to fly to Mt. McKinley or do glacier landings. We tried pushing it back to 1230pm, but at that point, we figured we'd just go ahead and fly the alternate route (not seeing McKinley) and not doing a glacier landing. Everyone there was very friendly and they accommodated us as best they could. We got a 2 hour flight for the price of a 1 hour flight and were very happy with the views and the pilot. Would def recommend flying with K2 and hope you have better weather than us!

Review Title: Amazing flight around Denali, Foraker and Hunter Peaks!
Review Text: We flew with K2 after deciding to drive up to Talkeetna to see Denali for the first time this year. On a whim, we dropped by the K2 "downtown" office and signed up for a flight. I was reluctant to fly on a small plane, but my fears were alayed once we got in the air. The day was perfect. 100% visability and not a cloud in the sky! Tony was our pilot and he told us a lot we didn't know about the Alaska range, Foraker and Hunter Peaks, Ruth Glacier, etc... We even flew right over a plane landing on the glacier and a mountain climbing base camp on McKinley! I highly recommend this excursion to anyone visiting Alaska. My only regret: that it took us 3 trips to AK from MI to find out it was that easy to flightsee Denali!

Review Text:
My partner and I are out in Alaska visiting my sister, her husband and my niece and were keen to do a flightseeing tour.

Our decision on which one to do, and whether to add a glacier landing, was much debated due to cost and desire to find a trip that felt personal.

We opted for K2 tours (partly swayed by the 10% off voucher in a local magazine - the visitor guides also have $20 off vouchers) and booked the day before.

Upon arrival at their base the glorious sunshine and friendliness of the reception staff made my sister and her husband decide that they too would like to fly. The staff were really helpful and able to arrange it so we could all do this together (despite the sunshine drawing in lots of visitors all wanting to fly!) and they were also great as they let their 8 month old daughter fly for free (in her car seat taking up a whole space - other companies say under 2's can fly for free on an adults lap).

The plane had the 5 of us and 1 other passenger in and felt small enough to be personal but large enough to feel safe. I didn't even realise that we had taken off and the baby slept through the landing!

Wow is all I can say really - it was so worth spending the additional money on the glacier landing and the pilot (Greg) was exceptional at pointing out things of interest and answering all our questions.

My sister and her husband are now planning to take all their visitors to Talkeetna to do this trip with K2, and are looking forward to doing the trip again themselves!

An unmissable experience.
